author: Stuart Prine
text: Our shallow irrigation well was no longer producing water but the pressure switch and motor were working. I had called several well services and no one could help until next week. Dee called me back and was able to come that afternoon. He quickly accessed the problems, mainly a failed bladder in the pressure tank. He also installed a pressure gauge, replaced a failed check valve and adjusted the pressure switch. Dee is very knowledgeable and very reasonable with his pricing! I highly recommend Well Dr and Accessories.

author: Greg Layne
text: Me.Dee was on time at the time he said he would be there. Went straight to the problem and fixed them. Very neat and clean with his work. Used all new parts including PVC. His price was more than fair for the work he performed. Will definitely use him again and have recommended him to several people. You will not regret using him and his services!!!

author: Sandra Martinez
text:
Well Dr, and particularly Mr. DEE were fantastic! Dee answered my frantic phone call at 5:30 on a Friday and took the time to walk me through the process of locating my well. He and his crew showed up as scheduled, kept in constant contact with me throughout the process and detailed next steps clearly, answering my many questions patiently. No “little lady” treatment or condescending attitudes here, like I’ve gotten from other well contractors!
Dee is super knowledgeable, courteous and professional and I would recommend him and his company highly for any of your well needs.

author: Candice Perry
text:
